# SPCTR / Specter Core

> Specter Core (SPCTR) is an open-source autonomous multi-agent platform: federation gateway, deterministic SQLite WAL broker, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and OpenAI-compatible inference gateway. MIT license. Author: Guilherme Peralta Novaes.

Canonical site: https://spctr-dv5u.onrender.com/
Source code: https://github.com/aigodsend15-ship-it/specter-core

## Core capabilities

- Autonomous multi-agent federation (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, local models)
- MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio server (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code)
- OpenAI-compatible inference gateway (POST /v1/chat/completions, SSE streaming)
- Deterministic broker with SQLite WAL, SHA-256 receipts, HMAC capabilities
- PowerShell/Bash interactive terminal hub with auditable session logs
